blocks.prompt:
1 Describe the structure of ATP. Explain how ATP transfers energy between metabolic reactions (ATP-ADP cycle). (4 marks)
(ATP ki banawat bayan karein. Wazahat karein ke ATP metabolic reactions ke darmiyan energy kaise muntaqil karta hai (ATP-ADP cycle).)
blocks.explanation:
ATP ki banawat: ATP (adenosine triphosphate) aik nucleotide hai jis ke teen hisse hain:
1. Adenine, nitrogen wali base
2. Ribose, paanch carbon wali sugar
3. Teen phosphate groups
Do phosphates ke darmiyan covalent bonds high-energy bonds hain.

Energy ka nikalna: jab aisa aik bond toot-ta hai to inorganic phosphate (Pi) alag hota hai aur har mole se taqreeban 7.3 kcal (7,300 calories) energy nikalti hai. Aam reactions mein sirf bahar wala P-P bond toot-ta hai:
ATP + H₂O → ADP + Pi + energy (7.3 kcal/mole)
Kuch soorton mein ADP bhi toot-ta hai: ADP + H₂O → AMP + Pi + energy (7.3 kcal/mole)

ATP-ADP cycle: cells khurak ki oxidation se energy le kar ADP aur Pi jor ke ATP banate hain aur zaroorat par ATP torte hain. ATP energy dene wale kaamon mein banta aur energy lene wale kaamon mein toot-ta hai; is tarah yeh reactions ke darmiyan energy muntaqil karta hai aur cell ki energy currency hai.

book_ref.quote: Cells get energy from the oxidation of food

blocks.prompt:
2 What is compensation point? Explain the gas exchange of leaves in darkness, at dawn and dusk, and at noon. (4 marks)
(Compensation point kya hai? Andhere mein, subah-shaam aur dopehar ko pattiyon ke gas tabadle ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Photosynthesis respiration ke products istemal karta hai aur respiration photosynthesis ke. Photosynthesis sirf din mein hota hai lekin respiration din raat chalti hai.

1. Andhere mein: pattiyan aur doosre hisse sirf respire karte hain; oxygen lete aur carbon dioxide chhorte hain.
2. Subah aur shaam: roshni kam hoti hai, is liye photosynthesis aur respiration ki rate thori der barabar ho sakti hai. Photosynthesis ki oxygen respiration ki zaroorat ke barabar aur respiration ki CO₂ photosynthesis ki zaroorat ke barabar hoti hai. Pattiyon aur hawa ke darmiyan gas ka koi net tabadla nahi hota. Yeh compensation point hai.
3. Dopehar ko: roshni aur photosynthesis ki rate barh jati hai. Respiration itni CO₂ nahi de sakti jitni chahiye, aur oxygen respiring cells ki zaroorat se zyada banti hai. Nateeja: oxygen ka net ikhraj aur carbon dioxide ka jazb.

book_ref.quote: Photosynthesis uses the products of respiration and respiration uses the products of photosynthesis

blocks.prompt:
3 Describe the structure of a chlorophyll molecule. Name the kinds of chlorophylls and state where they are found. (4 marks)
(Chlorophyll molecule ki banawat bayan karein. Chlorophylls ki qismon ke naam aur un ki jagah batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Chlorophyll aik lipid molecule hai. Is ke do hisse hain:
1. Hydrophilic head (paani pasand sar): porphyrin ring se bana hai jo chaar pyrrole rings (paanch kono wale nitrogen compounds) par mushtamil hai. Chaar pyrrole rings ko darmiyan mein magnesium atom jorta hai. Porphyrin ring roshni jazb karta hai. Chlorophyll a mein doosre pyrrole ring par methyl (CH₃) group aur chlorophyll b mein usi jagah aldehyde (CHO) group hai.
2. Hydrophobic tail (paani na-pasand dum): lambi hydrocarbon chain; yeh molecule ko thylakoid membrane mein jamati hai.

Qismein: chlorophyll a, b, c aur d plants aur algae mein hain; baqi photosynthetic bacteria mein hain aur bacteriochlorophylls kehlate hain.

Jazb: chlorophylls zyada tar violet-blue aur orange-red roshni jazb karte hain; green sab se kam jazb ho kar guzar jati ya palat jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Chlorophyll is a lipid molecule. Chlorophylls are of different kinds

blocks.prompt:
4 What are accessory pigments? Describe their kinds, where they are found and how they pass energy to chlorophyll a. (4 marks)
(Accessory pigments kya hain? In ki qismein, jagah aur chlorophyll a ko energy dene ka tareeqa bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Accessory pigments: chlorophyll a ke ilawa woh tamam pigments jo photosynthesis ke liye roshni jama karte hain.

Qismein aur jagah:
1. Chlorophyll b: plants mein.
2. Carotenoids (carotenes aur xanthophylls): plants mein. Beta-carotene jaise carotenoids ka dohra kirdar hai: blue aur green roshni pakarna aur photosynthetic nizam ko zyada roshni ke nuqsan se bachana.
3. Phycobilins: red algae aur cyanobacteria mein.

Energy ki muntaqili: roshni jazb kar ke accessory pigments energy chlorophyll a ki taraf dete hain. Plants mein aam tarteeb:
Carotenoids → Chlorophyll b → Chlorophyll a

Ahmiyat: kuch wavelengths jo chlorophyll a jazb nahi karta chlorophyll b achhi tarah jazb karta hai aur ulta bhi, is se jazb hone wali roshni ki range barhti hai.

book_ref.quote: When accessory pigments absorb light, they pass on the energy towards chlorophyll a

blocks.prompt:
5 What is an action spectrum? Describe how it is obtained and the first action spectrum made by Engelmann. (4 marks)
(Action spectrum kya hai? Yeh kaise hasil hota hai aur Engelmann ka pehla action spectrum bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Action spectrum: pigments mukhtalif wavelengths mukhtalif rate se jazb karte hain aur har wavelength photosynthesis mein mukhtalif had tak mo'assar hai. Wavelengths ki is ta'seer ko action spectrum ke zariye maloom kiya jata hai.

Tareeqa: plant par aik aik kar ke mukhtalif rangon ki roshni dali jati hai. Har rang par pattiyon se nikalne wali oxygen naap kar photosynthesis ki rate li jati hai. Is data ka graph action spectrum hai.

Engelmann ka kaam: pehla action spectrum German biologist T. W. Engelmann ne 1883 mein banaya. Unhon ne Spirogyra ke pigments par kaam kiya. Spirogyra filament ke cells par mukhtalif wavelengths dalne par blue aur red roshni pane wale cells mein sab se zyada photosynthesis hua aur sab se zyada oxygen nikli.

Nateeja: blue aur red roshni sab se mo'assar hai; action spectrum pigments ke absorption spectrum se milta hai.

book_ref.quote: For getting action spectrum of light, a plant is illuminated with different colours of light one by one

blocks.prompt:
6 Explain the following in photosynthesis: (i) the role of light (ii) the role of carbon dioxide. (4 marks)
(Photosynthesis mein yeh samjhayein: (i) roshni ka kirdar (ii) carbon dioxide ka kirdar.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Roshni ka kirdar: roshni woh energy deti hai jo saada molecules ko pechida organic compounds mein badalne wali reactions chalati hai. Chlorophyll roshni jazb karta hai aur yeh chemical energy ban kar organic compounds mein C-H bond energy ki shakal mein jama hoti hai. Plants mili solar energy ka sirf taqreeban 1-2% chemical energy mein badalte hain, phir bhi yeh zameen ki taqreeban sari zindagi ke liye kaafi hai. Blue aur red wavelengths sab se mo'assar hain.

(ii) CO₂ ka kirdar: sugar CO₂ ki ATP aur NADPH se reduction se banti hai, is liye CO₂ sugar ke liye carbon ka zariya hai. CO₂ stomata (jo pattiyon mein bari tadaad mein hain) se andar aa kar mesophyll cell walls ke pani mein hal hoti hai; is ka dakhla stomata ke khulne par munhasir hai. Aabi ajsam hal shuda CO₂, bicarbonates aur soluble carbonates, aur khushki wale hawa ki CO₂ istemal karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Sugar is formed by the reduction of CO₂ by using ATP and NADPH

blocks.prompt:
7 In non-cyclic photophosphorylation, describe (i) the absorption of light by PS-II and (ii) the photolysis of water. (4 marks)
(Non-cyclic photophosphorylation mein (i) PS-II ka roshni jazb karna aur (ii) pani ki photolysis bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) PS-II ka roshni jazb karna: jab PS-II par roshni parti hai to us ke antenna ke chlorophyll molecules ki energy level barh jati hai. Do excited electrons aage doosre chlorophyll molecules se hote hue reaction centre ke P680 chlorophyll tak pahunchte hain. P680 ki energy barhne se us ke do excited electrons PS-II ke primary electron acceptor ko chale jate hain. P680 mein electron 'hole' ban jata hai aur woh taqatwar oxidizing agent ban jata hai.

(ii) Pani ki photolysis: P680 ka 'hole' pani ke electrons se bharta hai. Pani ka molecule PS-II ke oxidized chlorophyll se mil kar do hydrogen ions, aik oxygen atom (jo foran doosre oxygen atom se mil kar O₂ banata hai) aur do electrons mein toot-ta hai. Yeh do electrons P680 ka 'hole' bharte hain. Pani torne ka yeh qadam photolysis hai. Photolysis ki oxygen fazai oxygen ka asal zariya hai.

book_ref.quote: When light falls on PS-II, the energy level of chlorophyll molecules of its antenna centre rises

blocks.prompt:
8 Describe the flow of electrons (i) from PS-II to PS-I and (ii) from PS-I to NADP⁺ in non-cyclic photophosphorylation. (4 marks)
(Non-cyclic photophosphorylation mein electrons ka bahao (i) PS-II se PS-I tak aur (ii) PS-I se NADP⁺ tak bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) PS-II se PS-I tak: P680 ke excited electrons jo PS-II ke primary acceptor ne liye, PS-II ki electron transport chain se PS-I tak jate hain. Is chain mein plastoquinone (PQ), cytochrome complex aur plastocyanin (PC) hain. Chain mein neeche jate hue electrons ki energy kam hoti hai; yeh energy thylakoid membrane chemiosmosis se ATP banane mein istemal karti hai. Saath hi PS-I roshni jazb karta hai aur us ke P700 ke excited electrons PS-I ke primary acceptor ko jate hain; PS-II se aane wale electrons P700 ka 'hole' bharte hain.

(ii) PS-I se NADP⁺ tak: PS-I ka primary acceptor electrons doosri electron transport chain ko deta hai jahan ferredoxin (FD) unhein leta hai. NADP reductase enzyme electrons FD se NADP⁺ ko deta hai. NADP⁺ do electrons aur aik H⁺ le kar NADPH ban jata hai jis mein high-energy electrons jama hote hain.

Is tarah roshni ki energy chemical energy (ATP aur NADPH) ban jati hai. PS-II aur PS-I aur chains se electrons ka zigzag rasta Z-scheme kehlata hai.

book_ref.quote: In the next step light energy is absorbed by PS-I

(Non-cyclic aur cyclic photophosphorylation ka tafseeli muqabla karein.)

blocks.prompt:
10 Compare chemiosmosis in the chloroplast with chemiosmosis in the mitochondrion. (4 marks)
(Chloroplast aur mitochondrion mein chemiosmosis ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono organelles mein electron transport chain aik hi tareeqe se ATP banati hai: carrier se carrier jate electrons ki energy H⁺ ions ko membrane ke paar pump karti hai; H⁺ gradient mein potential energy hoti hai, aur ATP synthase se wapas aate H⁺ ions ADP aur Pi ko jor kar ATP banwate hain.

blocks.prompt:
11 Describe (i) the reduction phase and (ii) the regeneration phase of the Calvin cycle. (4 marks)
(Calvin cycle ke (i) reduction phase aur (ii) regeneration phase bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(Carbon fixation pehle teen CO₂ aur teen RuBP se 3-PGA ke chhe molecules banata hai.)

(i) Reduction phase: chhe ATP se chhe phosphate groups le kar 3-PGA ke molecules mein lagaye jate hain, har 3-PGA 1,3-biphosphoglyceric acid ban jata hai. Phir har 1,3-biphosphoglyceric acid G3P mein reduce hota hai; hydrogen NADPH deta hai aur phosphate groups alag hote hain. Is qadam mein ATP aur NADPH kharch hote hain (ATP se ADP, NADPH se NADP⁺). Chhe G3P bante hain; aik cycle se bahar ja kar doosre G3P se mil kar glucose banata hai.

(ii) RuBP ki regeneration: kai reactions se baqi paanch G3P teen ribulose phosphate (RuP) bante hain. Light reactions ke teen ATP se har RuP par aik phosphate lag kar teen RuBP bante hain. Yeh RuBP dobara CO₂ lete hain aur cycle chalta rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: In this phase, six phosphate groups are taken from six ATPs and added to molecules of 3-PGA

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 5.12 mein ATP aur NADPH ke teer ulte (jaise yeh ban rahe hon) chhape gaye hain. Sahi yeh hai ke reduction phase mein 6 ATP aur 6 NADPH istemal hote hain, aur regeneration mein mazeed 3 ATP. Yeh sab light reactions se aate hain.

blocks.prompt:
12 Define cellular respiration. Why does glucose have more stored energy than CO₂ and H₂O? Why is glucose called respiratory fuel? Name the types of respiration. (4 marks)
(Cellular respiration ki definition likhein. Glucose mein CO₂ aur H₂O se zyada energy kyun hai? Glucose ko respiratory fuel kyun kehte hain? Respiration ki qismein batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Cellular respiration: woh aalmi amal jis se jandar carbon wale pechida compounds (maslan glucose) tor kar qabil-e-istemal energy lete hain; cells ko khurak ki qadam ba qadam oxidation se energy milti hai.
C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂ → 6CO₂ + 6H₂O + Energy
(Yeh external respiration ya saans lene se mukhtalif hai, jo jism aur mahol ke darmiyan CO₂ aur O₂ ka tabadla hai.)

Glucose mein energy: glucose ke atoms ki tarteeb mein CO₂ aur H₂O se zyada energy hai kyun ke glucose mein bohat se C-H bonds hain aur CO₂ aur H₂O mein aise bonds nahi.

Respiratory fuel: tamam cells mein respiration ke bunyadi waqiaat milte julte hain aur taqreeban tamam ajsam ke cells glucose ko energy ke liye istemal karte hain, is liye glucose respiratory fuel hai.

Qismein:
1. Anaerobic respiration (fermentation): oxygen ke baghair
2. Aerobic respiration: oxygen ki maujoodgi mein
Dono ke pehle qadam mein glycolysis se glucose do pyruvic acid (C₃H₄O₃) mein toot-ti hai; baad ki reactions mukhtalif hain.

book_ref.quote: Almost all cells in all organisms use glucose as energy source

(Aerobic aur anaerobic respiration ka tafseeli muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono glycolysis se shuru hoti hain jis mein glucose do pyruvic acid mein toot-ti hai; farq pyruvic acid ke anjaam aur hasil energy mein hai.

book_ref.quote: Anaerobic respiration happens in many microorganisms and in some cells of higher plants

blocks.prompt:
14 Describe the preparatory phase of glycolysis. (4 marks)
(Glycolysis ka preparatory phase bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Glycolysis cytosol mein hoti hai; har qadam aik khaas enzyme chalata hai aur ATP aur NAD⁺ bhi zaroori hain. Preparatory phase mein energy kharch hoti hai aur glucose toot-ti hai:

1. ATP se aik phosphate group glucose ko milta hai aur glucose 6-phosphate banta hai.
2. Glucose 6-phosphate apne isomer fructose 6-phosphate mein badalta hai.
3. Doosra ATP fructose 6-phosphate ko doosra phosphate deta hai aur fructose 1,6-biphosphate banta hai.
4. Fructose 1,6-biphosphate bohat reactive hai aur do teen carbon wale intermediates, G3P aur dihydroxy acetone phosphate (DAP), mein toot-ta hai. Yeh aapas mein badal kar do G3P bante hain.

Is tarah do ATP kharch hote hain aur aik glucose se do G3P bante hain jo oxidative phase mein jate hain.

book_ref.quote: It involves the expenditure of energy and the breakdown of glucose

blocks.prompt:
15 Describe the oxidative phase of glycolysis. Name the step that is an example of substrate-level phosphorylation. (4 marks)
(Glycolysis ka oxidative phase bayan karein. Woh qadam batayein jo substrate-level phosphorylation ki misaal hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Oxidative phase mein G3P se hydrogen nikali jati hai aur nikalne wali energy ATP mein pack hoti hai. Har G3P ke liye:

1. G3P apni acidic shakal mein oxidize hota hai: do hydrogen atoms (do high-energy electrons ke saath) NAD⁺ ko milte hain aur aik inorganic phosphate lagta hai. Is se 1,3-biphosphoglyceric acid (1,3-BPGA) banta hai.
2. 1,3-BPGA ka phosphate ADP ko milta hai; 3-phosphoglyceric acid (3-PGA) aur aik ATP bante hain.
3. 3-PGA, 2-phosphoglyceric acid (2-PGA) mein badalta hai.
4. 2-PGA se pani nikal kar phosphoenol pyruvic acid (PEP) banta hai.
5. PEP apna high-energy phosphate doosre ADP ko deta hai, ATP banta hai aur PEP pyruvic acid ban jata hai.

Substrate-level phosphorylation: aakhri qadam mein enzyme PEP (organic substrate) se phosphate ADP ko deta hai aur ATP aur pyruvic acid bante hain, baghair kisi membrane ya electron transport chain ke.

book_ref.quote: It involves the removal of hydrogen from G3P and packing of released energy in the form of ATP

blocks.prompt:
16 Answer the following about aerobic respiration: (i) Describe the oxidation of pyruvic acid. (ii) Explain why it is not true to say that respiration turns oxygen into carbon dioxide. (4 marks)
(Aerobic respiration ke baare mein: (i) Pyruvic acid ki oxidation bayan karein. (ii) Wazahat karein ke yeh kehna kyun durust nahi ke respiration oxygen ko carbon dioxide mein badalti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Pyruvic acid oxidation: pyruvic acid seedha Krebs cycle mein hissa nahi leta. Mitochondria mein yeh tabdeeliyan hoti hain:
1. Pyruvic acid se carbon dioxide ka aik molecule nikalta hai aur yeh acetaldehyde ban jata hai.
2. Acetaldehyde oxidize ho kar (hydrogen nikal kar) acetyl group banta hai; aik NAD⁺ NADH ban jata hai.
3. Acetyl group coenzyme A (CoA) se mil kar acetyl-CoA banata hai jo Krebs cycle mein jata hai.

(ii) CO₂ (pyruvic acid oxidation aur Krebs cycle mein) oxygen ke shamil hone se pehle nikal jati hai. Oxygen sirf electron transport chain ke aakhir mein electrons aur hydrogen ions le kar pani banati hai. Is liye sahi yeh hai ke respiration glucose ko carbon dioxide aur oxygen ko pani mein badalti hai.

book_ref.quote: It has to go through the following changes before entering the Krebs cycle

blocks.prompt:
17 Name the steps of the Krebs cycle in which CO₂ is released, NAD⁺ or FAD is reduced and ATP is formed. Why is FAD used at one step instead of NAD⁺? (4 marks)
(Krebs cycle ke woh qadam batayein jin mein CO₂ nikalti hai, NAD⁺ ya FAD reduce hota hai aur ATP banta hai. Aik qadam par NAD⁺ ki bajaye FAD kyun istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Citric acid cycle ke tamam qadam mitochondria mein hote hain. Acetyl-CoA, CoA aur acetyl group mein toot-ta hai; acetyl group chaar carbon wale oxaloacetic acid se mil kar chhe carbon wala citric acid banata hai. Phir:

1. Citric acid → alpha-ketoglutaric acid (5-C): oxidative decarboxylation; aik CO₂ nikalti hai aur aik NAD⁺, NADH banta hai.
2. Alpha-ketoglutaric acid → succinic acid (4-C): mazeed oxidation aur decarboxylation (CO₂ nikalti hai); succinic acid CoA se mil kar succinyl CoA banata hai.
3. Succinyl CoA → succinic acid + CoA: high-energy bond toot-ta hai aur energy se aik ATP banta hai.
4. Succinic acid → fumaric acid: do hydrogen atoms nikalte hain aur FAD, FADH₂ banta hai.
5. Fumaric acid + pani → malic acid.
6. Malic acid → oxaloacetic acid: aik NAD⁺, NADH banta hai; oxaloacetic acid agle acetyl CoA se milne ke liye azad hai.

FAD kyun: succinic acid se do hydrogen atoms nikalne par free energy NAD⁺ ko reduce karne ke liye kaafi nahi, is liye doosra electron acceptor flavin adenine dinucleotide (FAD) istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: All steps of the citric acid cycle occur in mitochondria

blocks.prompt:
19 Answer the following about the energy extracted from glucose: (i) Explain how many ATP are produced from an NADH of the Krebs cycle, an NADH of glycolysis and an FADH₂. (ii) Compare the ATP yield of aerobic and anaerobic oxidation of glucose. (4 marks)
(Glucose se hasil energy ke baare mein: (i) Krebs cycle ke NADH, glycolysis ke NADH aur FADH₂ se kitne ATP bante hain, wazahat karein. (ii) Glucose ki aerobic aur anaerobic oxidation ke ATP hasil ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Glycolysis aur Krebs cycle ke NADH aur FADH₂ apne energy-rich electrons electron transport chain ko dete hain aur chemiosmosis se ATP banta hai:
1. Krebs cycle ka har NADH teen ATP deta hai.
2. Glycolysis cytoplasm mein hoti hai, is liye us ka NADH mitochondrial membrane ke paar le jaya jata hai jis par har NADH ka aik ATP lagta hai. Is liye glycolysis ka har NADH aakhri hisaab mein teen ki bajaye do ATP deta hai.
3. Har FADH₂ do ATP deta hai.

(ii) Aik glucose ki aerobic oxidation se net 36 ATP milte hain. Anaerobic oxidation (sirf glycolysis) se sirf 2 ATP, jo glucose ki energy ka taqreeban 2% (14.6 kcal) hai. Is liye aerobic oxidation 36 ÷ 2 = 18 guna zyada efficient hai.

book_ref.quote: The NADH and FADH₂ produced during glycolysis and Krebs cycle pass on their energy-rich electrons

blocks.prompt:
20 Trace the pathway of photorespiration through the chloroplast, peroxisome and mitochondrion. (4 marks)
(Photorespiration ke raste ko chloroplast, peroxisome aur mitochondrion se guzarte hue bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Shuru (chloroplast): aam tor par rubisco RuBP mein CO₂ mila kar phosphoglycerate banata hai. Jab patti ke cells mein CO₂ ki nisbati miqdaar kam aur oxygen zyada ho to rubisco RuBP mein O₂ milata hai. RuBP aik phosphoglycerate aur aik phosphoglycolate (do carbon wala) mein toot-ta hai. Phosphoglycolate glycolate ban jata hai.

Peroxisome: glycolate chloroplast se peroxisome mein jata hai jahan O₂ se glyoxylate banta hai; is mein zehreela hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) bhi banta hai. Glyoxylate glycine ban jata hai.

Mitochondrion: glycine mitochondrion mein jati hai jahan do glycine se aik serine banta hai.

Wapas peroxisome aur chloroplast: serine peroxisome mein ja kar glycerate banta hai. Glycerate chloroplast mein ja kar phosphoglycerate ban jata hai jo Calvin cycle mein dobara ja sakta hai.

Nateeja: oxygen istemal hoti aur CO₂ nikalti hai, magar ATP nahi banta.

book_ref.quote: Glyoxylate is then converted to glycine, which is transported to mitochondrion

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 5.21 mein H₂O₂ ko chloroplast wale qadam (phosphoglycolate se glycolate) par dikhaya gaya hai aur glycerate ka teer phosphoglycolate par khatam hota hai. Sahi: H₂O₂ peroxisome mein glycolate se glyoxylate bante waqt banta hai, aur glycerate wapas phosphoglycerate banta hai, jaisa kitab ka text kehta hai.

blocks.prompt:
21 Answer the following about photorespiration: (i) What are C-3 plants? (ii) Explain how photorespiration arose as a problem during the history of the Earth and how much it costs C-3 plants. (4 marks)
(Photorespiration ke baare mein: (i) C-3 plants kya hain? (ii) Wazahat karein ke zameen ki tareekh mein photorespiration masla kaise bani aur yeh C-3 plants ko kitna nuqsan deti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) C-3 plants: woh plants jo Calvin cycle se carbon fix karte hain. In ki carbon fixation ka pehla product teen carbon wala compound (3-PGA) hai, is liye Calvin cycle ko C-3 pathway kehte hain.

(ii) Jab photosynthesis pehli baar wujood mein aaya to fiza mein oxygen bohat kam thi, is liye photorespiration kam ya na hone ke barabar thi. Lakhon saal baad free O₂ fiza mein jama hui aur rubisco ki aik hi active site ke liye CO₂ aur O₂ ka muqabla shuru hua. Is se photorespiration ka maujooda masla paida hua.
Nuqsan: C-3 plants photorespiration mein apne fix kiye carbon ka 25% se 50% kho dete hain aur paidawar kam hoti hai. Garam ilaqon mein jahan temperature aksar 28 °C se oopar hota hai yeh masla sangeen hai aur zarai paidawar par bara bura asar dalta hai.

book_ref.quote: After millions of years, free O₂ accumulated in the atmosphere

blocks.prompt:
22 What is CAM? Explain how CAM plants deal with the problem of photorespiration. (4 marks)
(CAM kya hai? Wazahat karein ke CAM plants photorespiration ke masle se kaise nimatte hain.)
blocks.explanation:
CAM crassulacean acid metabolism hai, plant family Crassulaceae ke naam par jis mein yeh pehli baar daryaft hua. Garam ilaqon mein bohat se succulent plants jaise cactus, pineapple aur kuch doosre groups CAM karte hain.

Tareeqa:
1. In plants mein stomata raat ko khulte aur din mein band rehte hain.
2. Din mein band stomata pani ka nuqsan aur CO₂ ka nikalna rokte hain.
3. Is liye carbon dioxide ki miqdaar zyada rehti hai aur photorespiration ki rate kam ho jati hai.
4. Din mein sugar banane ke liye CO₂ pichhli raat bane organic molecules se milti hai.
5. C-4 plants ki tarah CAM plants bhi C-4 aur C-3 dono pathways istemal karte hain.

book_ref.quote: The carbon dioxide necessary for producing sugar is provided from organic molecules made the night before

blocks.prompt:
23 Compare C-4 photosynthesis with CAM as adaptations to the problem of photorespiration. (4 marks)
(Photorespiration ke masle ke hal ke taur par C-4 photosynthesis aur CAM ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Garam ilaqon ke plants ne photorespiration se nimatne ke yeh do tareeqe banaye; dono rubisco ke gird CO₂ zyada rakhte hain aur dono C-4 aur C-3 pathway istemal karte hain.
